\n <p><b>Tradermon è un gioco educa:
Tradermon is an educational game. It does not provide financial advice or personalised recommendations.

The world and characters of Capitalia are fictional. Stocks, prices and charts are real: they come from Alpaca, a broker, through a free Paper account (fake money) that you link yourself. The stocks on display are chosen to teach, not to advise you. The quizzes draw on public financial education sources (SEC Investor.gov, Investopedia, Consob, Banca d'Italia, CFA Institute, ESMA).

It's a game for learning: it uses only the Alpaca Paper account and never uses real money. Without a linked account the study path remains. Outside the game, investing real money carries the risk of losing it.
